ja319:1.1: Susukhaṃ vata jīvāmi, labhāmi c' eva bhuñjituṃ paripanthe ca tiṭṭhāmi, kā su bhante gatī maman ti.
ja319:2.1: Mano ce te na-ppaṇamati pakkhi pāpassa kammuno avyāvaṭassa bhadrassa na pāpam upalippatīti.
ja319:3.1: Ñātako no nisinno ti bahu āgacchate jano, paṭiccakammaṃ phusati, tasmim me saṃkate mano
ja319:4.1: ti. Paṭiccakammaṃ na phusati mano ce na-ppadussati, appossukkassa bhadrassa na pāpam upalippatīti.
